desc:
This move starts a famous joseki---the sword of Muramasa. It's relatively simple but can still lead to complications.

<A:R14> gives Black territory on the right side as well as sente and is generally advisable. 

<B:P17> gives Black territory in the corner.

<C:P15> is the old joseki and just about the only move played before 2017, when AlphaGo revealed mistakes in the professionals' knowledge.

See [Michael Redmond, *AlphaGo vs. The World: Game 35, AlphaGo Master (W) vs. Jiang Weijie 9p (B)*](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zjEZDmYqRPg&t=398s) and [*Game 41, AlphaGo Master (W) vs. Kim Jiseok 9p (B)*](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wbh4iG4rH14&t=267s).

[Explanation by Simple Baduk on Youtube (SDK/Dan)](https://youtu.be/ANglGDKGhaY?si=fZ_t1ZtFCOo_KMhJ)
